headlines.title: PM announces summer infrastructure plan
headlines.summary: The Prime Minister has unveiled a major package of investment in rail, road and renewable energy projects, promising tens of thousands of jobs across the country.

headlines.title: Bank of England holds interest rate at 4.25%
headlines.summary: Policymakers voted seven to two to leave the base rate unchanged this month, citing easing inflation but persistent service-sector price pressures.

headlines.title: England beat Australia in cricket thriller
headlines.summary: A century from the captain saw England chase down a target of 287 at Edgbaston with one over to spare in front of a record crowd.

headlines.title: Heatwave forecast for southern England
headlines.summary: Temperatures could reach 30C across south and east England by Wednesday, the Met Office said, with an amber heat-health alert in force.

headlines.title: World leaders gather for climate summit
headlines.summary: More than forty heads of government are meeting in Brussels this week to agree new emissions targets ahead of the autumn UN talks.

headlines.title: Train strike called off after talks
headlines.summary: A planned three-day strike by rail workers next week has been suspended after union leaders accepted a revised pay offer from operators.

headlines.title: Tech firm reports record quarter
headlines.summary: Profits at the FTSE-listed software company jumped 38 per cent year-on-year, driven by strong demand for its cloud and AI products.
